job.question: In the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (BERS) RFP 2024-003 for investment consulting services, how many maximum evaluation points are assigned to the annual fee proposal?
job.expected_facts: 28 points (out of 100). Full breakdown: Program Plan/Narrative 18, Organizational Capacity/Knowledge and Experience 23, Demonstrated Effectiveness 22, Fee Proposal - Annual Fee 28, Fee Proposal - Hourly Rate 9.
job.acceptance: 28 points alone is sufficient. Other scoring categories and fee formula are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System investment-consultant RFP, not NYC BERS RFP 2024-003. It gives no maximum evaluation points for an annual fee proposal and says there is no predetermined formula for weighing fees.
quotes: The City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System (COAERS) seeks general investment consultant services
While these data points may be considered by Trustees, there is no predetermined mechanical formula contemplated for weighing fees against other criteria.
